usedFor: Barevalue edits podcast audio with AI; Dropbox is where the finished files live. When “New Completed Order” fires in Barevalue, “Upload File to Dropbox” can save the result to a folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Completed Order” in Barevalue, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: The trigger fires when the edit is done and its files are ready, so the finished episode lands in your archive without a manual download.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves from a public web link, so the order has to give one. “New Failed Order” carries no finished file, so skip it for uploads.
